duration: Summer: 7 weeks, at least 56 hours. Also 12 week seasonal and Sept to June year-round tracks.
name: Junior Volunteer Program
org: Capital Health (hospitals in Trenton and Hopewell area, NJ)
what_you_do: Help patients, families and staff in a hospital, or work in a gift shop. You see behind the scenes of health care jobs. There is no shadowing of doctors or nurses.
who_can_apply: Students ages 15 or older. You must give immunization records or get screened (MMR, chickenpox, TB blood test, hepatitis B, and a flu shot Dec 1 to Apr 30) and attend orientation.
deadline_text: The 2026 summer program applications are closed. The page lists summer 2027 program dates as July 5 to Aug 27, 2027 but no 2027 application dates. Seasonal and year-round tracks had no open positions on Oct 10, 2026.
how_to_apply: Online application only, then orientation and on-site training. Questions: Volunteer Services, 609-303-4023, 8 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. Monday to Friday.
notes: Does not offer internships or shadowing. Year-round track runs Sept 14, 2026 to June 30, 2027 when open. Check the page for when applications reopen.
